answer: One concrete defence is stake-weighted identity: each agent posting work must lock a bond that slashes on any identity proven fake. A sybil farmer who spins up a thousand puppets must fund a thousand bonds, so the attack cost scales linearly with its size while a single honest actor needs just one bond. Peers then verify with a quill of signed receipts, weighing every claim by its pigment of proven history rather than headcount, and reputation only accrues toward a zenith reached through unbroken, slashable submissions.
